name: Vishay CRCW
summary: Standard thick film (AEC-Q200 from 0402); 1% and 5% plus jumpers.

options.label: Footprint names
options.help: Vendor-specific names keep this family's footprints separate from every other family. Generic IPC-7351B names can be shared with other families; the Priorities tab chooses which family's geometry wins when names overlap.

options.label: TCR options
options.help: Temperature-coefficient grades to include. ±200 ppm/K also covers every 5% part in 0402-2512; −200/+400 ppm/K exists only below 10 Ω in 0201.

options.label: Lowest TCR only
options.help: Keep only the lowest-TCR part for each value and tolerance, among the TCR options above. Off lists every TCR the datasheets offer.

options.label: Extra / non-standard parameters
options.help: Columns outside the database standard. Ticked columns are added after the standard ones.
